_note: Owner corrections applied over the drafted registry at merge time (scripts/recipes/merge-drafts.mjs --corrections). Entries keyed by ingredient id deep-merge into the draft; `_additions` are whole entries the drafts do not carry.

product_coconut.as_purchased_note: grated flesh; one dehusked nut yields about 250 g
product_coconut.basis: Recipes quote coconut as grams of grated flesh (or nuts, 250 g of flesh each), so the edible fraction is 1 and a piece is the flesh of one nut; the price is per nut.
product_coconut.notes: Corrected from the draft, which set an edible fraction of 0.45 against the whole nut while recipes weigh the flesh.

pantry_coconut_milk.as_purchased_note: first squeeze of grated coconut, home pressed or a good tinned milk
pantry_coconut_milk.basis: Thick first-squeeze milk, close to USDA raw coconut milk (230 kcal). The draft averaged thick and thin; thin milk is its own entry so a recipe's second squeeze is not counted at first-squeeze richness.

_additions.as_purchased_note: second and third squeeze of the same grated coconut with more water

sources.name: USDA FoodData Central
sources.entry: Nuts, coconut milk, raw (liquid expressed from grated meat and water)

_additions.basis: A second squeeze carries roughly two fifths of the first squeeze's fat once the same flesh is pressed again with about twice the water; set at 95 kcal, between the MRI second-extract reading and household practice.
_additions.notes: Recipe lines whose preparation says thin or second squeeze are pointed here by the draft normaliser.

product_curry_leaves.as_purchased_note: sprigs, sold in a small bunch; a piece is one sprig of about 2 g
product_curry_leaves.notes: Recipes count sprigs, so a piece is a sprig rather than a single leaf.

pantry_kenda_leaf.notes: A piece is one leaf of about 5 g, used to wrap halapa.
